questions.question: How does it work?
questions.answer: 'The Testing Effect' made us know that learning by testing yourself is way more effective than just reading. StudyPhii was built to help students take advantage of that fact by providing AI-generated practice questions on ANYTHING

questions.question: Is there a free trial?
questions.answer: No there isn't. Running AI services is not cheap, but we decided to keep ours as low as possible. For comparison, ChatGPT costs $20/mo while StudyPhii costs less than $4/mo. It's way less if you get the lifetime plan.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: 1. Login with your Google Account. 2. Pick a plan. 3. Start learning.
